caption: The drawing features a large, dark-colored metal bucket with an oval-shaped top view and slightly tapered sides. The bucket is depicted in a monochromatic, gray scale, with shading to indicate its metallic texture. Attached to the bucket is a single, prominent wire handle that arches upward and forms a broad dip or notch at its highest point, creating a heart-like shape at the top. The handle is affixed to the bucket at two points on opposite sides near the rim. On the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, rectangular inset detail showing a close-up of one of the handle’s attachment points, displaying the rivets or fasteners securing the handle to the bucket. The overall composition is centered within a double-lined rectangular border, and the artist’s name, "Francis Law Durand," is written in small letters in the lower right area, just outside the primary illustration.
title: Fireplace Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
